description.purpose: Echoes the user turn back as an assistant turn and stamps `hop.route`: 'answer' normally, 'error' when the text starts in 'fail'.
description.use_when: Stand-in for a brain, so the fixture answers without a provider.
description.not_in_scope: No inference, no state, no tools.
examples: a user turn 'hello' leaves as an assistant turn 'echo: hello' on route 'answer'
